description: Create a Story Ad creative: 1-20 existing creatives (SNAP_AD, WEB_VIEW, APP_INSTALL or DEEP_LINK) shown in the given order, which cannot change later. With `preview` it also creates the tile shown in the Stories tab (a 3:5 PNG image, a headline of up to 55 characters, optional logo); without it the Story only runs between other stories. Creates creatives only, nothing delivers; use the returned creative with snap_create_ad (ad type STORY). Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

creative_ids.description: The Snaps of the Story, in order
